transcript: This is maybe the most insane show I've ever seen. Center of the universe stars Titus Burgess and Jane Krakowski. And the second that I saw these two were doing a show together, I said, absolutely, I am there. And you probably already know this, but their dynamic together is just unmatched. I mean, there's a reason why they've done so many shows together, like 30 Rock, unbreakable, Kimmy Schmidt, Schmigadoon. And speaking of schmigadoon, this was also directed by Chris Gatelli, who choreographed on that show. The basic premise for the show is that Titus and Jane are both separately booked to host a charity telethon for overpopulation, which they both interpret to mean that ugly people need to stop having kids. And since they both thought that they would be the sole host for the evening, the show sees them butting heads and butting egos. Um, but of course, by the end of the show, spoiler alert, they learn to overcome their ego and differences, and even learn that ugly people deserve happiness, too. This show was also being recorded for audible, so there are a lot of audio based gags in this show. I actually had a Foley artist on stage who was making a lot of the sounds, um, that you would hear throughout the show. One of the funniest was during a tap number set to define gravity. Uh, Titus and Jane just kind of moved their arms and pretended to tap dance while the Foley artist was banging tap shoes on a table, and that's how they got the tap sound. And the song list for this evening was insane. Um, I won't spoil all of the song choices, but it was a lot of musical theater, um, and a lot of, like, deep cut musical theater. There's also some non musical theater songs. Like a one point, Jane Krakowski sings a Lana Del Rey song, and then at another point, she sings let me be your star from smash, which, as a huge smash fan, made me very happy. Now, this was three nights only in New York City, and unfortunately, it is over now. But like I said, it will be on audible, so if you have an audio membership, hashtag not sponsored. Um, check this out when it drops, because this show is unhinged, and I feel like I've only scratched the surface of how crazy the show is.
